name: 19°C
source:
It's May, and she's in her fourth year of university. By the time the cherry blossom trees have lost all their petals, the protagonist was already busy looking for her first full-time job.

One beautiful spring day, she suddenly gets a phone call from a childhood friend, who's like an older brother to her.
She's going to have her last job interview today.
After rushing to the location, the protagonist is faced with an interviewer who keeps asking odd questions.

"Do you like money?"
"Um, yes. I do."

The always cheerful classmate from the university club, the unlikable guy from her part-time job.
The seasons slowly pass as she meets new people and bonds with them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6852]Freem![/url]]
translation:
现在是五月，她已经大学四年级了。当樱花树的花瓣落尽时，主角已经开始忙着寻找她的第一份全职工作。

在一个美丽的春日，她突然接到了一位青梅竹马的电话，这位青梅竹马的朋友对她来说就像是哥哥一样。
她今天将进行最后一次工作面试。
赶到现场后，主角遇到了一个不断问一些奇怪问题的面试官。

“你喜欢钱吗？”
“嗯，是的。我愿意。”

总是开朗的大学社团同学，打工时不讨人喜欢的家伙。
随着她结识新朋友并与他们建立联系，季节慢慢过去。
